method: One cold sample per version/device/profile, three warm reloads per save size. Gzip HTTP on localhost, aggregate server shaping includes worker traffic. Simulated Android, not hardware. Reload includes replay, cached assets and rendering. Heap after explicit GC is a snapshot, not a leak test. Body and header bytes counted by server; excludes TCP/TLS overhead. Initial unthrottled clicks predated FCP and were discarded; four unthrottled profiles retaken after awaiting FCP plus two animation frames. All retained slow profiles have recorded FCP earlier than the real click. Network rate is a nominal cap per 50ms tick; Windows timer scheduling attained about 160000 bytes/s, not a calibrated 1.6Mbps network. Single samples; do not infer acceleration.
